The Magical Forest & the Feather Map

A curious picture, a glowing forest, and a tiny bird who needs help finding home.

Read a story starter ✦

In a quiet garden stood an old bird-house with a crooked roof. Daisy lived there with Chip and Caty. Every morning, they watched the sun climb over the fence.

One rainy day, Chip found a picture tucked beneath their nest. It showed trees with glowing leaves.

“The Magical Forest,” Daisy read. “My grandmother told me it lies beyond the hills.”
